values.note: Park's own 2027 rate sheet (same as 2026): on-season (April-October) basic/walk-in $15, electric 50A $29, electric/water 50A $32, sewer/electric/water 50A $35; off-season (November-March) $14 / $25 / $26 / $29. Rates include sales tax. $6.50 online reservation fee per site.

values.note: On the reservation system: Loop 1 equestrian electric/water 50A, 9 sites (56-92 ft; bookable by non-equestrian campers year-round); Loop 2 sewer/electric/water 50A, 19 (55-90 ft); Loop 3 electric 50A, 21 (54-85 ft); Loop 4 basic, 14 (53-70 ft); Loop 5 walk-in tent platforms, 14. Plus camper cabins and a special-use camping area.

values.note: Missouri State Parks' reservation site or 877-422-6766, up to 12 months ahead. 'The campground is fully reservable'; 'Reservable sites may be available on a walk-up registration basis if the site is not reserved.' The booking system here sets a 2-night minimum for Friday and Saturday arrivals in every season checked (January, April, June and October 2027; Sunday-Thursday arrivals 1 night) - not on the agency's list of seven two-night-weekend parks. Camping is limited to any 15 days within a 30-consecutive-day period.

booking.source: https://mostateparks.com/park/johnsons-shut-ins/camping ('The campground is fully reservable'; walk-up line; 12-month window; 15-in-30 rule) + https://msprdr.usedirect.com/MSPRDR/rdr/search/grid PlaceId 47 (Restrictions MinimumStay 2 for arrivals 2027-01-15, 2027-01-16, 2027-04-10, 2027-06-11, 2027-06-12, 2027-10-16; MinimumStay 1 for 2027-01-12, 2027-06-13, 2027-06-15; MaximumStay 15), read 2026-11-06

note: Wooded campground in five loops north of the shut-ins day-use area: Loop 1 equestrian, Loop 2 full hookups, Loop 3 electric, Loop 4 basic and Loop 5 walk-in tent platforms, plus camper cabins. The shut-ins parking lot normally fills by 10 a.m. Memorial Day to Labor Day. --Claude
summary: Park camping page, the park's 2027 rate sheet and the US eDirect grid: confirmed 50-amp full hookups and rates (2027 unchanged from 2026, dated 2027 now); added 77 sites (63 drive-in incl. 9 equestrian that anyone may book; RV sites 53-92 ft), facilities, fcfs after_cutoff (was 'some_sites': the campground is fully reservable) and a 2-night Friday/Saturday-arrival minimum the engine enforces year-round.
